# Voxel City Generator

A Pen created on CodePen.

Original URL: [https://codepen.io/jkantner/pen/VYPBBjM](https://codepen.io/jkantner/pen/VYPBBjM).

A procedurally generated voxel city in Three.js. Reshape the grid, zoning, and skyline live, or scrub the 24-hour clock and watch the shadows sweep as the windows light up!
